namespace PubDC10

def starEdges : Nat → List (Nat × Nat)
  | 0 => []
  | k + 1 => (0, k + 1) :: starEdges k

theorem starGraph_deg_center (k : Nat) : (starEdges k).length = k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih => simp [starEdges, ih]
